version: LOCK 96 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - a dry fountain in every town
builds_on: LOCK 26 (the first three Names), LOCK 15 (the first fountain), LOCK 40 and 47 (two stars), LOCK 34 runner, LOCK 36 roads.

words.title: A dry fountain
words.text: The town fountain has been dry since its pipe cracked. The mason says {n} coins would mend it.
words.named: Mend it with your name carved
words.done_named: The mason carves your name on the basin. By evening, children are splashing in it.
words.done_secret: The mason carves only: for the sake of Allah. By evening, children are splashing in it.
